chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Dawud al-Sarri, who said:
I asked him about the Night Prayer and the Witr prayer, so he said, "It is obligatory."
ai.seo_question: Is the Night Prayer (Salat al-Layl) and Witr considered obligatory in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Dawud al-Sarri inquires of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) regarding the legal status of the Night Prayer (Salat al-Layl) and Witr. The Imam’s concise ruling that they are 'obligatory' (wajib) underscores their elevated status in Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing them from mere recommended acts and emphasizing their role in spiritual refinement and closeness to God.
